about: Playable .fink.js stories published by danbri/glitchcan-minigam (and isle_of_glitch) on GitHub Pages. Listed in the Fink story picker; each is fetched and compiled on first use. Needs FINK_EXTERNAL_HOSTS to include danbri.github.io. Checked with glitchcan-minigam `npm run fink:check` on 2026-11-01.
